title: Bus Routes
summary: Given an array of bus routes, each represented as a sequence of bus stops, determine the minimum number of buses needed to travel from the starting bus stop to the destination bus stop.
statement: Given an array of bus routes, each represented as a sequence of bus stops, determine the minimum number of buses needed to travel from the starting bus stop to the destination bus stop. Return -1 if the journey is impossible.
constraints: Each route repeats indefinitely and contains distinct stop numbers.
You may board any route containing your current stop and transfer at shared stops.
Return the minimum buses needed from source to target, or -1.
hints: Index routes by every stop they serve.
Breadth-first search reachable stops while boarding each route at most once.
Boarding a new route advances the bus count once and exposes all its stops.
BFS layers count buses, and marking routes prevents redundant scans without removing any transfer path.
editorial: BFS layers count buses, and marking routes prevents redundant scans without removing any transfer path.

tests.explanation: Ride the first route to seven and transfer to the second route.
No sequence of shared stops connects the source and target routes.
